messages:
Morgan: FYI escalation from @customer-acct: tool call fails with 400 schema_error. They say our endpoint is OpenAI-compatible but their tool args use a different enum.
Ashley: Can you paste the failing payload?
Morgan: Pasting cURL from customer:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/responses \
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-cust' \
 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
 -d '{"model":"gpt-4o-mini","input":"Run ticketing tool","tool_call": {"name":"create_ticket","arguments":"{\"title\":\"Error on checkout\",\"urgency\":\"critical\"}"}}'
```
Devon: Ah, arguments is a stringified JSON. OpenAI tool-calling expects arguments as an object when using structured tool definitions.
Priya: Also their enum is `urgency: critical|urgent|low`, our tool schema uses `priority: low|normal|high` and the values don't map.
Morgan: Here's our schema for create_ticket they hit (from model registry):
```json
{"name":"create_ticket","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"title":{"type":"string"},"priority":{"type":"string","enum":["low","normal","high"]}},"required":["title","priority"]}}
```
Ashley: The response from our API they're seeing:
```json
{"error":{"type":"invalid_request_error","message":"tool arguments failed JSON schema validation","details":"/priority: is a required property"}}
```
Devon: Because they passed `urgency` string inside a stringified arguments payload, validation looks for `priority` and fails.
Morgan: Customer claims older OpenAI-compatible SDKs accepted stringified args; they switched to new model and now it's strict.
Priya: Steps to repro:
1) Use their payload above
2) POST to /v1/responses with model gpt-4o-mini and same tool config
3) Observe 400
Morgan: Short-term workaround: send arguments as JSON object and map urgency->priority. Example payload:
```json
{"tool_call":{"name":"create_ticket","arguments":{"title":"Error on checkout","priority":"high"}}}
```
Ashley: Proposed support reply: explain schema mismatch, include mapping table (critical/urgent -> high, normal -> normal, low->low) and show fixed payload. Offer code snippet in their SDK.
Devon: We should also add a compatibility note in docs and maybe accept legacy stringified arguments automatically for a grace period.
Priya: Logging: request-id x-abc-123, customer org acme-corp, SDK version in header x-client: openai-js/4.2.1
SupportBot: Ticket #4521 created and assigned to eng-runtime.
Morgan: Assigning to @Devon to evaluate auto-parse legacy arg strings. I'll loop in product for enum mapping policy.
Devon: I'll take it. ETA EOD tomorrow for a proposal.
Ashley: Thanks — I'll send the customer repro steps + workaround now :thumbsup:
